mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without any triggering condition.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly year-over-year increase in CPIAUCSL above 5.0% triggers market expectations of prolonged monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a contraction in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction effect (measured by the product term in a regression) has a Rank IC below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 3.5%, a monthly increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200k signals robust labor market strength, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS > 200k, or the Rank IC for the conjunction condition is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average indicates weakening manufacturing activity, reducing corporate profit expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days without any triggering condition.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1.2 million units triggers market concern about broader consumer spending slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST < 1.2, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200k per month signals a tight labor market that accelerates wage growth and consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to the interaction effect between these two labor market indicators.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases above 200k, or the interaction term (UNRATE * PAYEMS) has a Rank IC below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a high monetary policy rate regime (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), a decline in the federal funds rate to below 4.25% triggers market expectations of imminent rate cuts, causing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 4.25% and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.
